SELECT
  delivery_bucket,
  MAX(bucket_shipment_count) AS shipments_count,
  COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN min_days_to_next IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_customers_with_next_order,
  ROUND(
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY min_days_to_next) FILTER (WHERE min_days_to_next IS NOT NULL)
  , 0) AS median_days_to_next_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    tenant_id,
    user_id,
    delivery_bucket,
    MIN(days_to_next) AS min_days_to_next,
    MAX(bucket_shipment_count) AS bucket_shipment_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      tenant_id,
      user_id,
      delivery_bucket,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_order_at - delivered_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_to_next,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY delivery_bucket) AS bucket_shipment_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        o.tenant_id AS tenant_id,
        o.user_id AS user_id,
        CASE WHEN (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at) <= INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'on-time' ELSE 'late' END AS delivery_bucket,
        s.delivered_at AS delivered_at,
        (
          SELECT MIN(o2.placed_at)
          FROM orders o2
          WHERE o2.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
            AND o2.user_id = o.user_id
            AND o2.placed_at > s.delivered_at
            AND o2.placed_at <= s.delivered_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
        ) AS next_order_at
      FROM shipments s
      JOIN fulfillments f ON f.id = s.fulfillment_id
      JOIN orders o ON o.id = f.order_id
      JOIN tenants t ON t.id = o.tenant_id
      WHERE t.name IN (
          'Kibblewick', 'Studio Vrij', 'Petalcourt Beauty',
          'Marrowby & Vane', 'Cragsley Outfitters', 'Ampfeld Elektronik'
        )
        AND s.delivered_at >= DATE '2025-09-01'
        AND s.delivered_at < DATE '2025-10-01'
        AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
    ) shipment_level
  ) days_level
  GROUP BY tenant_id, user_id, delivery_bucket
) customer_level
GROUP BY delivery_bucket
ORDER BY CASE WHEN delivery_bucket = 'on-time' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, delivery_bucket
note: Customer-level "has next order" and "days to next order" are computed per shipment's delivered_at and then collapsed to one value per customer within the bucket (earliest qualifying next order across their September shipments), since a customer can have multiple shipments in the same bucket; shipments_count still counts all shipments in the bucket.
